title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Expand Funko Collab With Saja Boys Blind Box and Worldwide Chase
summary: The Funko Pop! x 'KPop Demon Hunters' merch also includes Rumi, Zoey and Mira in 'How It's Done' outfits.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Fans of HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys can get ready for a “Takedown” by collecting all their favorite characters in Funko form — from Jinu to Rumi and even Derpy. Each vinyl figure is available now at Walmart and Amazon , with prices varying and multi-buy savings on select pops. But the toy brand’s latest addition includes a little mystery.

Available Sept. 17 with estimated shipping two days later, each blind box contains one figurine — either one of the five Saja Boys (Jinu, Abby, Baby, Romance and Mystery) or Crying Demon. Furthermore, fans get to hunt for a 1-in-72 Limited Edition Mystery Chase or a 1-in-1 Worldwide Chase where only a single figure exists.

BLIND BOX

Funk Pop! 'KPop Demon Hunters' Saja Boys Blind Box

Pre-Order

$14.99

Buy Now on Amazon

Discover the excitement of unboxing with the Funko Pop! Saja Boys blind box.

Every character has a 1-in-6 chance, while lucky collectors may uncover the ultra-rare Limited Edition Mystery Chase or the legendary one-of-a-kind Worldwide Chase. Each sealed blind box includes one 3.75-inch vinyl figure, featuring Jinu, Abby, Baby, Romance, Mystery or the unforgettable Crying Demon from Netflix’s hit animated film. Perfect for collecting, trading and displaying, this officially licensed Funko collectible is a must-have for KPop Demon Hunters fans, Funko enthusiasts, and lovers of surprise mystery figures everywhere.

The original KPop Demon Hunters Funk collection consists of 4.3-inch figures of Rumi, Mira, Zoey , Jinu and Derpy with Sussie.

Funko Pop! Kpop Demon Hunters – Set of 3 Huntr/x – Rumi, Mira and Zoey Vinyl Figures

$55.00 $63.87 14% off

A three-piece set of KPop Demon Hunters .

Right now, Amazon is running a special deal on a set of three figures, making up all the members of HUNTR/X for just $55.00. That’s 14% off the OG price, giving you the opportunity to collect all of the girl group members to add to your collection.

Funko Pop! Animation: KPop Demon Hunters Jinu Figure

$14.71

$13.95

Buy Now at walmart

Funko also has a figure of Jinu from KPop Demon Hunters .

Each character appears in their movie-accurate costumes made of sturdy vinyl. If you or a loved one are as obsessed with KPop Demon Hunters as the rest of the world, then you’ll want to jump on this collaboration ASAP.

The collection makes a great gift for collectors or HUNTR/X and Saja Boys superfans, both young and old. Sitting on a shelf or placed on your work desk, these figures add a ton of personality to any space.

Funko Pop! Animation: Kpop Demon Hunters – Derpy with Sussie

$14.88

A glow-in-the-dark Derpy and Sussie figure.

Accompanying the collector’s items, you’ll also have the option to create your own Funko figure through the Pop! Yourself option on Funko’s website. Pricing for your personalized figure will vary based on the options you choose. On the company’s website, select whether you want a singular figure or a duo. Once selected, you’ll then choose your collectible’s skin tone, hairstyle, facial features, outfits and more.

POP! Yourself

Buy Now at funko

Create your own Funko Pop! complete with KPop Demon Hunters lightsticks.

There’s a bunch of options to choose from. You also have to tackle the impossible task of deciding which group you want to rep. Are you a HUNTR/X fan or loyal to the Saja Boys? Whichever one you choose, your collectible will be able to hold a lightstick for your desired group. (You can pick both if you can’t decide.)

Netflix’s animated KPop Demon Hunters dropped in June 2025, capitalizing on the massive popularity of K-pop and South Korean culture. The film is centered around a fictional K-pop girl group HUNTR/X, consisting of members Rumi, the lead vocalist of the group; Mira, the dancer; and Zoey, the rapper. The group performs while secretly slaying demons when not on stage in order to keep peace throughout the world.
